race.comment: SCOOPED (5) showed pace when fresh from a two-month lay-off last start over this distance at Balaklava but felt the pinch in the closing stages. Fitter for that hit-out and enjoys a lovely run from the good draw. Should be right there at the pointy end. STREET LEGAL (7) returns from a three-month spell. In the money at all four runs last time in work including a game second when resuming in a similar maiden to this off a much longer break. Only missed the frame once in eight starts so expect him to play a key role. LIGHT BRIGADE (2) has not appeared since showing pace and finishing third on debut over 1200m at Strathalbyn in May. Going well at the jump-outs and this shorter trip should play into his hands. CHIX DIGGUS (8) is back after a four-month break. Didn't threaten in the two runs of his maiden campaign but the addition of blinkers this prep may spark improvement. COLD COPY (1) is another who has been underwhelming but may benefit from the addition of a set of shades.
